mostWorthwhile.text: Making the Moon was most worthwhile: the pale stone reflecting sunlight gave a clear explanation of why moonlight is gentler.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making burning stones was straightforward setup; its purpose was clear, but the step offered less to think about than what followed.

surprise.text: The storm gathered unlit stones into a rocky world rather than the galaxy I expected; their collisions and joining made a vivid result.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary, though the storm's ability to gather both stones and lights follows the story's mythic logic rather than a scientific explanation.

continue.text: Yes. The reflected-light explanation and the unexpected rocky world make me curious how the story will develop its world, though the compatible-choice menu leaves less room to discover recipes independently.
